from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CostDetail(BaseModel):
    """A specific fee or cost item mentioned in the document."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The monetary amount of the fee")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears this fee")
    fee_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 案件受理费，鉴定费)")
    stage: Optional[str] = Field(description="Procedural stage (e.g., 一审，二审)")

class DocumentMatchInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document for matching purposes."""
    title: str = Field(description="Document title or identifier")
    case_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of legal dispute")
    parties: List[str] = Field(description="Names of involved parties (appellants, appellees, etc.)")
    ruling_outcome: Optional[str] = Field(description="Summary of the court's final decision")
    costs: List[CostDetail] = Field(description="Financial details and fee distribution")
    courts: List[str] = Field(description="Names of courts involved")
    unique_facts: List[str] = Field(description="Specific distinguishing facts (e.g., inheritance ratios, property usage arrangements)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentMatchInfo]
